about.headline: One chippy who handles the whole job, and cleans up after.
about.body: Most people want the same things from a renovation: a fair quote, someone who organises the trades in the right order, and a site that's left clean every day. Every job runs that way, from a handrail to a full bathroom.

realReviews.author: Jeremy Wagstaff
realReviews.text:
Tom and his team did an outstanding job completing a full bathroom renovation for me recently and the end result speaks for itself. Tom handled the entire project and was able to organise each trade in the order they were needed. A surprising quick turnaround between demolition and handover, I was very impressed.
As a tradesman myself, I can now recommend his services to my clients knowing that they're in good hands.
Happy days.

realReviews.author: Carol Bell
realReviews.text: We employed Tommy  to build a timber and stainless wire handrail onto our existing deck. His design suggestions were taken onboard and the result is amazing. We are very pleased with his work. He is professional and punctual and  kept us informed during the whole process. We have no hesitation in recommending Conolly Carpentry and Construction.

realReviews.author: Jerry Naly
realReviews.text: Just had Tom build a mezzanine in my garage at Biggera Waters and he did a great job. I would not hesitate to recommend him to anyone. Great young man to deal with.

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your reno or deck?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward chat about the job.

faq.a: Send the job through the form or give Tom a ring. We'll come and have a look and send a written quote with the scope and price.

faq.q: Do you organise the other trades for a bathroom reno?
faq.a: Yes. Each trade is organised in the order it's needed, so you only deal with one person from demolition to handover.
The Gold Coast from Ormeau and Pimpama down to Tweed Heads, including Helensvale, Broadbeach, Robina, Burleigh and Tamborine Mountain.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a time to look at the job.
